highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates to Chrome m154 and ships XML documentation alongside NuGet packages.
highlights_body: HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the bundled native source; review the corrected and removed enum members before upgrading.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is renamed
breaking.body: CCC133 is corrected to CCC132 to match upstream HarfBuzz while retaining numeric value 132. Rename source references to CCC132.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined is removed
breaking.body: Aggregate Defined flag masks are not exposed because they are not independent options. Replace GlyphFlags.Defined with the concrete flags your application requires.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome m154 and incorporates current upstream bug and buffer upload fixes.

bullets.lead: XML API documentation ships with packages
bullets.detail: NuGet packages now include compiler-generated XML documentation, with source documentation authored directly alongside the managed API.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Chrome m154 rendering engine update.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the HarfBuzz source pinned by Skia, keeping the managed surface synchronized while excluding unsupported callback-heavy APIs.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 introduces the Chrome m154 rendering engine.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: It begins the 4.154 release line with the current upstream renderer.
